messages:
Sam: handing off — seeing sustained disk IO pressure on eu-west1 storage pool (storage-eu-3). Regen and embed-ingest latency up, some timeouts. Details and actions below.
Maria: noted. Any customer-facing 5xxs or just latency?
Sam: mostly latency. Regen latency ~3x, embed-ingest encountering timeouts (30s) for ~4% of requests. No broad 5xxs yet. Affected routes: /v1/regen, /v1/embeddings/ingest.
Cheng: I'm in the middle of the runtime PR (#1802). Can pause rollout if needed — pinging infra.
oncall-bot: INCIDENT INC-5234 created — Disk IO spike detected in eu-west1 storage pool (sev: 2).
Leo: I started draining pods from storage-eu-3. Command run: `kubectl cordon storage-eu-3 && kubectl drain storage-eu-3 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`.
Maria: good. Any fallback routing we can enable immediately? cache fallbacks or model downgrade?
Sam: enabled fallback to small-model-1 for regen canary, added routing preference to eu-west2 for embeddings. Paused non-essential deploys — @Cheng hold the current canary. Also updated runbook note: consider scaling storage pool +2 nodes.
Cheng: paused canary for #1802 and revoked traffic. Watching logs.
Leo: relevant log snippet from storage-eu-3:
```
W 03:12:14 storage-eu-3 iops=15000 baseline=4000 latency=320ms
E 03:12:16 embed-ingest timeout=30s request_id=abcd1234
```
Maria: PR followups — #1799 needs review from @Sam, #1805 needs perf signoff (I'm taking #1799).
Sam: ack. I'll pick up #1805 after handoff. Left runbook note: if IO doesn't drop in 30m, spin up 2x nvme-high nodes and migrate.
oncall-bot: PagerDuty alert cleared for regen-latency at 03:45 UTC, but disk pressure metric remains elevated — continuing to monitor.
Leo: next steps: finish cordon+drain, spin up replacement nodes in eu-west1 (2x nvme-high), ETA ~18m. If no improvement, shift embed traffic to eu-west2 and open support ticket with cloud provider (I'll draft).
Cheng: holding all deploys until 05:00 UTC. Will post any error spikes to this thread.
Maria: taking overnight oncall. I'll own the follow-ups and post a summary at ~04:00 UTC. @Sam anything else I should know?
Sam: nothing else. Thanks all :thumbsup: Will be reachable for review if needed.
